title: Seed of Renewal
description: A dockworker named Osk and two others in his tenement row have a sickness no poultice of ours touches, and their landlord is already asking when the rooms come free. The Seed of Renewal lies deep in Willow Dale, guarded.

objectives.description: Travel deep into Willow Dale ruins
Defeat the ancient guardians protecting the seed
Bring the seed to Priestess of Gaela

notes: Threat: named - a dockworker, Osk (invented), and two neighbours facing eviction on top of illness, a townsman's stake distinct from Tam's fever in gaela_08. Giver motive: the priestess is treating both the sickness and what it will cost them if it drags on. Consequence: not wired. Known duplicate of gaela_08_seed_of_life, deliberately differentiated - this copy is Dalhurst tenement workers facing eviction as well as illness; the temple copy is Tam, a Thornfield plague victim, and the church's decision to finally risk the guardians for him.
